file_change.purpose: Verify Core Build scope enforcement, basic Conformance/Assurance gating, lineage, non-circular acceptance, default-deny authorization, and state advancement.
implementation: Open a BuildSession around a minimal accepted Plan and temporary repository.
Assert unauthorized target paths and operations fail immediately.
Assert Build cannot finalize without the mechanical and semantic evidence required by Core.
Assert acceptance cannot self-authorize or arise from incidental repository/platform activity.
Assert successful Build acceptance preserves Core lineage and advances accepted implementation state.
Assert Assurance findings cannot directly mutate normative authority.
Assert governed state with no resolvable accepted authorization or governed extension point is rejected by default.
Assert minimal Conformance reports and Build mutation manifests are identity-bearing and resolvable from acceptance lineage.
Assert Build may start from an authorized Planning-artifact-only descendant of the declared implementation predecessor.
Assert implementation realization cannot be reclassified as Planning-only to bypass predecessor or mutation-scope enforcement.
Assert Governance lineage references required bootstrap Conformance and Assurance evidence without treating candidate-runtime output as its own prerequisite.
Do not require rich rejection history, generalized authority-lifecycle mutation, or exhaustive platform-capability hardening in FS0-Core.
